1.consolidated_definition: Parada. Señal que obliga a detenerse. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Compuesto: stop payment. Él se come dos señales de stop sin disminuir la velocidad, usa su bocina liberalmente al acercarse a la intersección
1.en_consolidated_definition: Stop sign. A signal that compels one to stop. Raw anglicism, relatively infrequent. Compound: stop payment. He eats two stop signs without reducing speed, uses his horn liberally as he approaches the intersection.
